name: Crusch Karsten
original_name: クルシュ・カルステン
source:
The head of Karsten house, which is known to have strong ties to the late royal family, and one of the candidates for the royal election to become the 42nd King of Lugnica. Crusch's ideal is free the country from the centuries long heavy dependency on the Dragon's guidance which she believe has led Luginca into stagnation and stripped the country's will to govern without it, betraying the hopes of the conservative ruling class who pin her as favorite to win the election. Crusch is honest, sincere, right, being a type of person who is destined to stand above others, though she has talent and has worked hard to reach where she is now. She prefers to act herself and has the pride of a warrior, but is also very dense and often believes the false knowledge jokingly told to her by Ferris, and sometimes displays an airheaded side.
